transcript.content:
Based on what I found, I can see you have many saved sessions (30 of them!), but unfortunately **I cannot read the actual messages or conversation history from old sessions**.

What "loading" a session does is basically restore your work/commands back to where that session left off, allowing you to continue from that point. But it doesn't give me access to view what conversations happened in those past sessions.

So I can:
- List all saved sessions
- Load a session to resume from where it ended
- Rename a session
- View details about the latest/current session

But I can't read through the actual chat history stored in any of those sessions. The content appears to be ephemeral and only accessible as an active, live session.
